name: Усунення захисника (2)
description: In chess, it's important to pay close attention to your opponent's defensive pieces. A piece with an important defensive role can reveal a weak spot in the opponent's position. By eliminating a crucial defender, the coherence of the opponent's position can collapse, giving you free access to their vulnerable pieces. Eliminating a defender makes a previously well-protected piece vulnerable.

examples.text: The rook in the center of the board is only protected by the knight. By eliminating the knight, White wins material.
Just like in the previous exercise, White can win material by eliminating the defender of the rook. This time, it happens by first investing a rook.

texts: The white knight is a key defender.
